title: Annual Reward Certificate and Plus Guarantee Parameters — Northgate Memberships
content:
The year-end side of Annual Reward on Northgate Memberships — certificates and the Plus guarantee — turns on six figures that differ between the two Plus tiers and the rest.

| Tier | Minimum year-end balance converted into a certificate (USD) | Months after the reward year's end the certificate can be redeemed | Times one lost certificate may be reissued | Certificate may pay a renewal fee | Plus guarantee applies | Days after the end of the membership year to claim the guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | No | No | 0 |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | No | No | 0 |
| Northgate Club Membership | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | No | No | 0 |
| Northgate Business Membership | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | No | No | 0 |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 5.00 | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | Yes | 60 calendar days |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | 5.00 | 12 calendar months | 1 | Yes | Yes | 60 calendar days |

## What each column means

1. **Minimum certificate.** The smallest year-end balance converted into a certificate; a smaller balance carries into the next membership year.
2. **Validity.** The number of calendar months after the reward year's end during which the certificate can be redeemed.
3. **Reissues.** How many times one lost certificate may be reissued.
4. **Renewal tender.** Whether an Annual Reward certificate may be used to pay a renewal fee.
5. **Plus guarantee.** Whether the Plus guarantee applies: a member whose year's Annual Reward is below the tier's Plus premium may claim under it.
6. **Claim window.** The number of calendar days after the end of the membership year during which the guarantee may be claimed.

## Reading the table

The non-Plus tiers show 0 or No throughout, because they earn no Annual Reward. Both Plus tiers share the same figures: a 5.00-dollar minimum certificate, 12 months of validity, 1 reissue, renewal payment allowed, and a 60-day guarantee claim window.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a Club Plus year that ends with a balance of 4.80 dollars produces no certificate, the balance being below 5.00; a balance of 5.00 dollars exactly reaches the minimum.
